context.purpose: Turn bounded numeric tables into editable, recalculated ODS and XLSX workbooks with checked summary formulas and a CSV round trip. Optional named cell bounds and weighted reconciliation enforce declared numeric performance in both native formats.
context.assumptions: Exactly one table, 2 to 10000 finite numeric rows, 1 to 64 named columns. CSV paths are absolute. Native LibreOffice runs headlessly with an isolated user profile.
context.constraints: No arbitrary spreadsheet formulas, strings, styles or general workbook editing. Column units are authored labels; no automatic unit conversion. Floating-point tolerances are explicit.
context.inspection: Inspect data.csv through table/series views and reopen the native workbooks. Independent host checks validate numeric cells, formulas and recalculated caches in both formats.
context.recovery: INVALID_TABLE requires rectangular finite data with valid column names. INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND requires a configured soffice. Preserve conversion logs and retry a corrected input in a fresh run. REQUIREMENTS_UNMET retains numeric assessments and workbooks; REQUIREMENT_SELECTION_FAILED identifies missing/text cells. Inspect observed margins and retry corrected input in a fresh attempt.

lifecycle.timeout: Each native process is bounded by the runner timeout; conformance adds an independent wall-clock watchdog.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared owned-process cancellation retains partial evidence. Pre-launch cancellation is tested separately from shared in-flight cleanup.
lifecycle.logs: Fresh run directory retains authored input, effective plan, native submissions/stdout/stderr, publications and verification evidence.
lifecycle.verification: Independently parse ODS/XLSX data, formulas and cached summaries and compare the CSV round trip and publication hashes. Recompute each declared requirement from both native formats; reject altered, linked, malformed or oversized assessment evidence.
